name: Subtitle-Edit
description: Run native Linux Subtitle Edit in a web browser. Includes FFmpeg, libmpv, Tesseract OCR, browser audio, GTK file chooser integration, persistent settings, and Intel/AMD hardware video decoding. No Wine or virtual machine is used.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent Subtitle Edit settings, GTK bookmarks, OCR databases, downloaded language models, and GUI state.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Media and subtitle files. Select files under /data inside Subtitle Edit.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Browser interface over HTTP. The default host port remains 3001 for compatibility with earlier releases.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: Numeric ID used to access mapped files. Unraid normally uses 99.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: Numeric group ID used to access mapped files. Unraid normally uses 100.

variables.name: Browser audio
variables.description: Stream Subtitle Edit audio through the browser. The browser may require one click before allowing playback.

variables.name: Keep application running
variables.description: Restart Subtitle Edit inside the container if its main window is closed.

variables.name: Initial display width
variables.description: Initial virtual desktop width in pixels. Browser remote resizing can adjust it later.

variables.name: Initial display height
variables.description: Initial virtual desktop height in pixels. Browser remote resizing can adjust it later.

variables.name: Secure connection (optional)
variables.description: Set to 1 for direct HTTPS with a generated self-signed certificate. Normally leave disabled when HTTPS is provided by a trusted reverse proxy.

variables.name: Web authentication (optional)
variables.description: Set to 1 to enable jlesage web authentication. Direct authentication also requires Secure connection to be enabled.

variables.name: Web authentication username
variables.description: Optional username used when web authentication is enabled.

variables.name: Web authentication password
variables.description: Optional password used when web authentication is enabled.

devices.name: Intel/AMD GPU device (optional)
devices.description: Enter /dev/dri to enable Intel or AMD rendering and hardware video decoding. Leave blank for CPU-only operation.
